messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: api-gateway (edge) elevated 502/504 rate detected — 12% error rate over last 5m across eu-west/na-east. Pager sent to on-call team.

emily_oncall: Paging in. I'm on it — checking dashboards (latency +5s p95) and recent deploys.

paul_sre: I can see 502 fanout from the ingress mux to backend pool B (timeouts followed by connection reset). Logs: `upstream reset: connection aborted` repeated.

sam-eng: Running quick curl against health endpoints: `curl -v https://api.redwood.example/health -I` returns 502 from edge in eu-west.

emily_oncall: Any recent config or rollout? I see a traffic spike to model-serving cluster that correlates with error onset ~6m ago.

paul_sre: No infra deploys in last 30m. There was a canary config push to rate-limiter rules 10m ago (PR #4123). Rolling back as a precaution.

sam-eng: Rolling back PR #4123 now: `deploy-bot: rollback config/rate-limiter to rev 8b2d`

deploy-bot: Rollback started for config/rate-limiter (triggered by sam-eng). Status: in-progress.

kate-support: Heads-up: PagerDuty shows ~40 active incidents from customer integrations hitting 502. Putting customers with high SLA on notify list.

paul_sre: Mitigation checklist: 1) Enable ingress circuit-breaker to short-circuit failing backend pool. 2) Shift 30% traffic to na-east and ap-south pools. 3) Temporarily increase connection timeout to 15s.

emily_oncall: Executing 1 & 2 now. `curl -X POST https://infra-api/route-control -d '{"shift":30,"to":"na-east"}'` (using infra token).

sam-eng: Circuit breaker enabled on pool B: `muxctl cb enable pool-B 60s`. Observability: error-rate heading down to 7% after CB and traffic shift. p95 latency still elevated.

paul_sre: Confirmed backend pool B is overloaded — queue depth spike and kube pods OOM kill count small but restart loop present. Scaling pool B by +3 pods and bumping CPU limit for model workers.

deploy-bot: Autoscaler action: Created 3 extra model-serving replicas in cluster-model-east, status: successful.

emily_oncall: After scaling + CB + shift, errors trending toward baseline (2.1%). Will monitor for 10m then start slow traffic rampback.

nora-pm: Noted customer impact: some requests returned 502 for approximately 8–10 minutes, primarily read-heavy inference endpoints. Triage doc: https://incident.redwood/3189994321.

kate-support: Sending proactive emails to top 5 affected customers and opening support tickets.

paul_sre: Action items for postmortem: - root cause: backend pool B saturation under sudden prefix KV-cache miss storm - improve autoscaling thresholds and add early fallback path. - add synthetic canary hitting rate-limiter change path.

emily_oncall: Handoff to night on-call in 25m. Current status: stabilized, error-rate ~1.9%, monitoring alert still open but no regression yet.

nora-pm: I'll draft the incident brief and notify sales about impacted customers. We should schedule a follow-up meeting tomorrow.

emily_oncall: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as command-log. If errors spike again, re-open the bridge. :white_check_mark:

kate-support: Noted. I updated the support channel and added mitigation notes.

paul_sre: Closing active escalations if no regression in 30m. Leaving observation checks in place.

incident-bot: ALERT: rollback of config/rate-limiter completed (triggered by sam-eng). Monitoring for side-effects.

emily_oncall: Last check at 3189994600: error-rate steady at 1.8%, latency p95 improving. Handoff complete to night on-call (paul_sre). Thread will be updated if anything changes.
